Module cave_hold "A cave hold" {
  Description "A cave in a hillside behind a screen of brambles: a mouth where the watch sits, a smoky cavern, a ledge up a notched log where the chief sleeps, a pit for captives, a dry side-cave for plunder, a crack that looks out over the road, and a chimney that comes out on the hillside above.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place land "The region" is region.
  Place outside "The approach" is room.

  Place lair "the cave" is site within land.
  Place mouth "the cave mouth" is room within lair at 0, 1.
  Place cavern "the smoky cavern" is room within lair at 1, 1.
  Place ledge "the high ledge" is room within lair at 1, 0.
  Place pit "the captives' pit" is room within lair at 2, 1.
  Place cache "a dry side-cave" is room within lair at 2, 0.
  Place crack "the spy-crack" is room within lair at 0, 0.
  Place hillside "the hillside above the cave" is room within lair at 1, 2.
  Initially Assert unlit(pit). Initially Assert unlit(cache). Initially Assert unlit(crack). Initially Assert indoors(cavern).

  Passage brambles "the brambles across the cave mouth" is passage between outside and mouth taking 10 minutes.
  Passage cave_throat "the throat of the cave" is passage between mouth and cavern.
  Passage notched_log "a notched log" is climb between cavern and ledge.
  Passage pit_rope "a rope ladder down into the pit" is climb between cavern and pit.
  Passage cache_crawl "a crawl into the side-cave" is crawl between cavern and cache.
  Passage crack_way "a cleft in the wall" is passage between mouth and crack.
  Passage chimney "the chimney" is climb between cavern and hillside taking 30 minutes hidden until backway_known needing climbing or rope.
  Passage hill_path "a goat-track down the hillside" is path between hillside and outside taking 20 minutes.

  Observe mouth_scene at mouth when true "The cave mouth, behind its brambles: a fire-blackened ceiling, gnawed bones, and a stool for whoever keeps watch.".
  Observe cavern_scene at cavern when true "A big smoky cavern with a fire in the middle and the smoke going up into a black hole in the roof. A notched log leans against the wall up to a ledge; a rope ladder hangs into a pit.".
  Observe ledge_scene at ledge when true "A ledge high in the cavern wall, out of the smoke: a bed of skins, and a chest.".
  Observe pit_scene at pit when true "A pit with sheer sides and a muck floor. You would not climb out of it without the rope.".
  Observe cache_scene at cache when true "A dry side-cave stacked with plunder.".
  Observe crack_scene at crack when true "A cleft in the rock that looks straight down on the road below.".
  Observe hillside_scene at hillside when true "The open hillside above the cave. Smoke comes out of a hole among the rocks.".
  Observe chimney_hint at cavern when not knows(party, backway_known) "The smoke goes up the hole in the roof as if it had somewhere to go.".

  Thing chest "a chest on the ledge" at ledge {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "A chest stands on the ledge, locked.".
    State open "The chest on the ledge stands open.".
    Change pick "Pick the chest's lock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change smash "Break the chest open" from locked to open needing brawn.
  }
  Thing heap "a heap of plunder" at cache {
    Holds.
  }
  Discovery backway_known "The smoke-hole in the cave's roof is a chimney that comes out on the hillside above; a climber could go up or down it." {
    Found by searching cavern "Up the smoke-hole there is daylight, and a crack worn by hands and feet: a chimney, and someone climbs it.".
    Found by searching outside with woodcraft "Up the hillside, smoke comes out of a hole among the rocks, and there is a goat-track to it.".
    Found by searching hillside "Among the rocks the smoke comes out of a crack you could climb down, with a rope or a good grip.".
  }
  Goal false.
}

data/rules/passages.kyr:
Module world_passages "Passages, obstacles and the condition of things" {
  Kind passage. Kind condition. Kind change. Kind thing. Kind waykind. Kind hazard.
  // What is seen and changes but is not handled: the weather, a river, a beacon on a far hill.
  Kind scenery.
  Relation passageKind(passage, waykind). Measure travelTime(passage).
  // A way walked in less than a watch: how many minutes (see ActionTime.minutes).
  Measure travelMinutes(passage).
  // A way that opens only while something holds (Passage … opening when …), while it does not.
  Relation unopened(passage).
  Relation connects(passage, place, place).
  Relation on(entity, passage).
  Relation guards(group, passage).
  Relation state(entity, condition) exclusive.
  Relation blocksWhen(entity, condition). Relation harmsWhen(entity, condition).
  Relation hurtsWith(entity, hazard). Relation hurtsInto(entity, condition).
  Relation revealedBy(entity, fact).
  // Containment: a thing or item inside another, reachable while that one is not shut; a receptacle can take more.
  Relation inside(entity, entity). Relation receptacle(entity). Relation closesWhen(entity, condition).
  // A hazard that strikes a company: the world turns it on one of its members (a trap sprung, a stone that falls).
  Relation strikes(hazard, group).
  // What can be tried on a thing (looked over closely, prodded, pried at...), and what has been.
  Kind verb. Relation probeable(entity). Relation suits(entity, verb). Relation tried(entity, verb).
  Relation needs(entity, entity).
  Relation changeOf(change, entity). Relation changeFrom(change, condition). Relation changeTo(change, condition).
  // A change only one side reaches (the bar on the cellar side of a door) is made from that place.
  Relation changeAt(change, place).
  Query placedFor(a: group, c: change) means not changeAt(c, ?p) or (changeAt(c, ?p) and at(a, ?p)).
  Relation changeKnows(change, fact). Relation consumes(change, good). Relation spends(change, itemkind).
  Relation hobbled(group).
  Relation following(group, group).
  Query holding(a: group, k: itemkind) means memberOf(?m, a) and ownedItem(?i, ?m) and itemKind(?i, k).
  // Carrying a particular thing: this key, not any key.
  Query carries(a: group, i: entity) means memberOf(?m, a) and ownedItem(i, ?m).
  // What a way or a change needs: a skill, a kind of thing, or one particular thing.
  Query meets(a: group, n: entity) means capable(a, n) or holding(a, n) or carries(a, n)
    or (following(a, ?l) and holding(?l, n)).
  Query equippedFor(a: group, x: entity) means not needs(x, ?n) or (needs(x, ?n) and meets(a, ?n)).
  Query informedFor(a: group, c: change) means not changeKnows(c, ?f) or (changeKnows(c, ?f) and knows(a, ?f)).
  Query visibleTo(w: passage, a: group) means not revealedBy(w, ?f) or (revealedBy(w, ?f) and knows(a, ?f))
    or (revealedBy(w, ?g) and following(a, ?l) and knows(?l, ?g)).
  Query barred(w: passage) means (on(?o, w) and state(?o, ?s) and blocksWhen(?o, ?s)) or unopened(w).
  // Who holds the key to what bars a way, and those who serve them, go through it as if it were open.
  Relation keyholder(group, entity).
  Query opens(a: group, o: entity) means keyholder(a, o) or (serves(a, ?m) and keyholder(?m, o)).
  Query barredFor(w: passage, a: group) means on(?o, w) and state(?o, ?s) and blocksWhen(?o, ?s) and not opens(a, ?o).
  Query watched(w: passage) means guards(?g, w) and able(?g) and state(?g, ?t) and blocksWhen(?g, ?t)
    and at(?g, ?p) and connects(w, ?p, ?q).
  Query obstructed(w: passage) means barred(w) or watched(w).
  Query watchedAgainst(w: passage, a: group) means guards(?g, w) and able(?g) and state(?g, ?t) and blocksWhen(?g, ?t)
    and at(?g, ?p) and connects(w, ?p, ?q) and not allied(?g, a) and not tolerates(?g, a).
  Query hazardous(w: passage) means on(?h, w) and state(?h, ?s) and harmsWhen(?h, ?s).
  // Something that can do harm, in a state where it does none: a trap gone off, or one made safe.
  Query harmless(t: entity) means harmsWhen(t, ?h) and state(t, ?s) and not harmsWhen(t, ?s).
  Query mobile(a: group) means not hobbled(a) or following(a, ?l).
  Query together(a: group, b: group) means at(a, ?p) and at(b, ?p).
  Query shut(c: entity) means state(c, ?s) and closesWhen(c, ?s).
  // A thing hidden until something is known is not there, for a company that does not know it; nor is a thing on a way
  // the company does not know of.
  Query onHiddenWay(x: entity, a: group) means on(x, ?w) and not visibleTo(?w, a).
  Query noticed(x: entity, a: group) means (not revealedBy(x, ?f) or (revealedBy(x, ?f) and knows(a, ?f)))
    and not onHiddenWay(x, a).
  Query reaches(a: group, t: entity) means noticed(t, a) and ((at(a, ?p) and at(t, ?p))
    or (at(a, ?q) and on(t, ?w) and connects(?w, ?q, ?r))
    or (at(a, ?q) and guards(t, ?w) and connects(?w, ?q, ?r) and at(t, ?r))
    or (at(a, ?h) and inside(t, ?c) and at(?c, ?h) and not shut(?c))).
  Query passable(w: passage, a: group) means visibleTo(w, a) and not barredFor(w, a) and not watchedAgainst(w, a)
    and not hazardous(w) and not unopened(w)
    and equippedFor(a, w).
  Goal false.

  Action go(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place) "Take {way} to {destination}" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and passable(way, actor)
      and mobile(actor).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert at(actor, destination). }
    Seen "{actor} takes {way} toward {destination}.".
  }
  Action slip_past(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place, gatekeeper: group) "Slip past {gatekeeper} by {way}" {
    Description "Someone who moves quietly takes the company past a watcher without a fight or a bargain. The watcher stays where it is, and will be there on the way back.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and guards(gatekeeper, way)
      and able(gatekeeper) and state(gatekeeper, ?t) and blocksWhen(gatekeeper, ?t) and not tolerates(gatekeeper, actor)
      and (at(gatekeeper, origin) or at(gatekeeper, destination))
      and capable(actor, stealth)
      and visibleTo(way, actor) and not barred(way) and not hazardous(way) and equippedFor(actor, way) and mobile(actor).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert at(actor, destination). }
    Result "One at a time, keeping low and downwind, you slip past {gatekeeper}.".
  }
  Action risk(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place, trap: entity, blow: hazard, after: condition, victim: member) "Risk {trap}; {victim} goes first" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and on(trap, way)
      and state(trap, ?s) and harmsWhen(trap, ?s) and hurtsWith(trap, blow) and hurtsInto(trap, after)
      and memberOf(victim, actor) and awake(victim) and visibleTo(way, actor) and not obstructed(way)
      and equippedFor(actor, way) and mobile(actor).
    Resolve expose(blow, victim).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert state(trap, after). Assert at(actor, destination). }
    On failure { Assert state(trap, after). }
  }
  Action change_thing(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition) "{how}" {
    Time 3 minutes.
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and placedFor(actor, how) and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and not consumes(how, ?g) and not spends(how, ?k).
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). }
  }
  Action change_thing_spending(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition, spent: item, form: itemkind, carrier: member) "{how}, using {carrier}'s {spent}" {
    Time 3 minutes.
    Description "What it takes is used up doing it.".
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and placedFor(actor, how) and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and spends(how, form) and memberOf(carrier, actor) and awake(carrier)
      and ownedItem(spent, carrier) and itemKind(spent, form).
    Resolve drop(spent, carrier).
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). }
    Result "{carrier}'s {spent} is used up.".
  }
  Action change_thing_paying(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition, spent: good) "{how}" {
    Time 3 minutes.
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and placedFor(actor, how) and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and consumes(how, spent) and quantity(actor, spent) >= 1.
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). Decrease quantity(actor, spent) by 1. }
  }
}

    { "id": "journey-depart.rain.1", "when": { "sky": "rain" }, "text": "You leave {from} with your hood up and the rain in your face." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.rain.2", "when": { "sky": "rain" }, "text": "It rains on and off the whole way, the soft rain that gets in everywhere." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.rain.3", "when": { "sky": "rain" }, "text": "Rain comes over in grey curtains, one after another, and between them the country shines." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.afternoon.rain", "when": { "time": "afternoon", "sky": "rain" }, "text": "You set out from {from} in the middle of the afternoon, and the rain sets out with you." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.evening.rain", "when": { "time": "evening", "sky": "rain" }, "text": "You leave {from} late, in rain, with the light going early under the cloud." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.cold.1", "when": { "sky": "cold" }, "text": "It is cold enough to see your breath, and the ruts are hard with frost." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.cold.2", "when": { "sky": "cold" }, "text": "You walk fast to keep warm, and it does not help much." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.wind.1", "when": { "sky": "wind" }, "text": "A wind comes across the open country and leans on you the whole way." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.fog.1", "when": { "sky": "fog" }, "text": "Fog lies on the {way}, and things come out of it one at a time: a gate, a tree, a stone." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.grey.1", "when": { "sky": "grey" }, "text": "You leave {from} under a low lid of cloud that never quite comes to rain." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.grey.2", "when": { "sky": "grey" }, "text": "The sky is one grey from edge to edge, and the light is the same at every hour of the way." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.hot.1", "when": { "sky": "hot" }, "text": "The heat sits on the {way} like a weight, and you walk slower than you meant to." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.ash.1", "when": { "sky": "ash" }, "text": "Ash comes down soft as snow the whole way, and greys everything it settles on, you included." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.afternoon.1", "when": { "time": "afternoon", "sky": "fair" }, "text": "You set out from {from} in the full of the afternoon, the {way} pale with dust." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.evening.1", "when": { "time": "evening" }, "text": "You leave {from} late, with the light already going yellow." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.evening.2", "when": { "time": "evening" }, "text": "The shadows are long when you leave {from}, and getting longer." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.night.1", "when": { "time": "night" }, "text": "You go out of {from} into the dark, by what light there is." },
    { "id": "journey-depart.any.1", "text": "You set out from {from}." },

    { "id": "journey-land.river.1", "when": { "land": "river" }, "text": "Partway, the {way} goes down to the water and through it, and up the far bank with your boots full." },
    { "id": "journey-land.river.2", "when": { "land": "river" }, "text": "The {way} follows the river a while, close enough to hear it, and crosses where it runs wide and shallow." },
    { "id": "journey-land.lake.1", "when": { "land": "lake" }, "text": "For a while the {way} runs along a shore, and birds get up off the water as you pass." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fen.1", "when": { "land": "fen" }, "text": "The {way} goes out across the fen on a raised bank, reed on either hand taller than a man, open water glinting through it." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fen.2", "when": { "land": "fen" }, "text": "Out on the fen the sky is enormous, and the only things standing up in all that flatness are you and a heron." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fen.3", "when": { "land": "fen" }, "text": "Water stands on both sides, and the {way} between is soft enough to take the print of your boot and keep it." },
    { "id": "journey-land.wood.1", "when": { "land": "wood" }, "text": "For an hour the {way} runs under trees, and the light comes down green and broken through the leaves." },
    { "id": "journey-land.wood.2", "when": { "land": "wood" }, "text": "The {way} goes into the wood, and the wood closes over it, and for a long time there is nothing to see but the next bend." },
    { "id": "journey-land.wood.3", "when": { "land": "wood" }, "text": "Somewhere in the wood someone is cutting timber; you hear the axe a long time and never see who." },
    { "id": "journey-land.meadow.1", "when": { "land": "meadow" }, "text": "The {way} runs between hedges and small fields, past a farm or two where dogs bark at you over the gate." },
    { "id": "journey-land.meadow.2", "when": { "land": "meadow" }, "text": "It is easy going through open country: a mill, a ford, a man ploughing who stops to watch you go by." },
    { "id": "journey-land.meadow.3", "when": { "land": "meadow" }, "text": "Larks go up out of the grass on either hand, and come down again behind you." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fell.1", "when": { "land": "fell" }, "text": "The {way} climbs onto open moor, and the country falls away behind you in long brown folds." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fell.2", "when": { "land": "fell" }, "text": "Up on the tops there is nothing but heather, sky and wind, and a cairn now and then to say you are still on the {way}." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fell.3", "when": { "land": "fell" }, "text": "The {way} goes up by stony steps and down by worse, and the wind finds you on every rise." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fell.4", "when": { "land": "fell" }, "text": "Sheep stand on the {way} and watch you come, as if you were the one who had strayed." },
    { "id": "journey-land.fell.5", "when": { "land": "fell" }, "text": "There are no trees up here, and after the first mile no walls: only the {way}, the sky, and the long backs of the hills." },
    { "id": "journey-land.peak.1", "when": { "land": "peak" }, "text": "The {way} climbs into the hills, switching back and forth on itself, until the land you came from is small below you." },

    { "id": "journey-dark.1", "text": "The light goes before you are halfway, and you walk the rest by guess and by the pale line of the {way}." },
    { "id": "journey-dark.2", "text": "Night comes on while you are still on the {way}. An owl keeps pace with you for a while, and then thinks better of it." },

    { "id": "journey-arrive.town.1", "when": { "size": "town" }, "text": "{to} shows ahead a long while before you reach it: smoke, a roofline, the noise of it on the wind." },
    { "id": "journey-arrive.village.1", "when": { "size": "village" }, "text": "The smoke of {to} comes up over the next rise, and then the roofs." },
    { "id": "journey-arrive.hamlet.1", "when": { "size": "hamlet" }, "text": "{to} is a handful of roofs at the end of the road, and a dog that comes out to see who you are." },

    { "id": "journey-long.1", "text": "It is a long walk, and your feet know it by the end." },
    { "id": "journey-long.2", "text": "By the end of it you are footsore, and glad of the sight of anywhere at all." },
    { "id": "journey-long.3", "text": "The last mile is the longest, as it always is." }
  ]
}
